notes.title: 1.0.4 - Level Difficulty
notes.notes:
After reading comments on yesterday's update, I've published a build with a new-and-improved level 35.
There is now more space at the bottom of the level, leaving more opportunities for shots.
Other levels have been modified in this way too.

I also wrote new code for the aim-assist line, meaning that it stays on/off for the duration of your session once it's toggled.

notes.title: 1.0.3 - Aim Assist
notes.notes:
After studying initial player feedback, I'm happy to announce the following changes to [i]Bubble Shot[/i]:

By clicking the crosshair button, or pressing the 'up' arrow on your keyboard, you'll be able to see a target line. This should help us make more difficult shots and bounce off walls more effectively.
While introducing this feature, I was able to improve the accuracy of the bubble launcher itself too.

There are also changes to the bubbles which we are given to shoot. From now on, there will always be two different colours of bubbles queued for the launcher (unless there is only one colour of bubble remaining in the game area!).

Thanks for leaving your comments and reviews, it helps me make improvements to the [i]Bubble Shot[/i] experience!

notes.title: 1.0.1 - Bubble Switching
notes.notes:
I've just published an update with a feature which should help us on the harder levels.
By pressing the 🡻 key ("down" arrow key) you'll be able to switch your current bubble with the next one.
You can do this as many times as you wish, too.
Let's get some high scores!
